messages:
katie: Heads-up — security will enable org-wide MFA enforcement next Monday (2026-04-06). This affects all user accounts + any long-lived tokens that bypass MFA. We are not disabling service accounts, but we need all automation moved to short-lived creds (OIDC/GHA, Workload Identity, etc.) by 2026-05-01. Please read the migration playbook: https://intranet.redwood/ops/mfa-migration :eyes:

omar: Quick Q — what about GitHub Actions workflows that still use PATs in secrets? We have a few repos using PATs for npm publishing and repo-level package updates.

katie: Good call @omar — those need to be converted to OIDC or GitHub App installations. From the playbook: recommended order = 1) migrate publish jobs to the org GitHub App, 2) use OIDC for cloud provider auth, 3) rotate any remaining PATs to short TTL and file a ticket if vendor doesn't support OIDC. Example OIDC snippet for GHA: 

```yaml
permissions: write-all
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Assume role
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v2
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gha-deploy
          aws-region: us-west-2
```

katie: If you can't migrate by the deadline, open an infra ticket so we can approve a temporary exemption and help implement a short TTL flow.

jen: Security note — exemptions are limited. We will only approve: 1) air-gapped on-prem service accounts, 2) hardware-backed automation with documented rotation. All approved exemptions must have rotation/expiry <= 90 days and an owner.

matt: What about Datadog / PagerDuty / Terraform Cloud integrations that use org-level tokens? We have a half-dozen teams with infra tied to those.

katie: For SaaS integrations: use OAuth apps / integration keys where possible. For Terraform Cloud, switch to OIDC if using cloud creds, or rotate workspace tokens via the API on a schedule. I'll coordinate with Platform to publish step-by-step for the big vendors.

ci-deploy-bot: Reminder: automated scan ran on 2026-04-01 and found 12 repos with PATs in org-secrets. See https://intranet.redwood/security-scans/scan-20260401

sre-oncall: For self-hosted runners: if you rely on a runner that only supports PAT-auth, create a ticket (infra#2667) so we can stage a runner patch or provide a hosted runner fallback.

omar: Thanks — I'll start converting our publish job this week. If I hit a blocker I'll ping @katie or open infra#2667.

jen: Security will host two office hours: Wed 10am and Fri 3pm (Zoom link on the playbook) for teams that need hands-on help. Please drop example workflows before the session so we can prep. :calendar:

katie: Thanks everyone. TL;DR: MFA enforcement next Mon, service accounts not deleted but migrate to short-lived creds by 2026-05-01 or file ticket. Ping me or @jen for exceptions. :thumbsup:
